notes.key_messages:
• On average candidates performed equally well on questions involving verbal and numerical
problems but less well on those based on diagrams.
notes.general_comments:
The number of candidates sitting the exam continued to increase by a further 9.7% and rose to 11 370 in
total. The mean score fell from 18.91 to 18.44. Only 5 candidates scored full marks (down from 62 in 2011),
while the proportion of candidates scoring 8 marks or below fell from 3% to 2%. The standard deviation
narrowed significantly.
The surprisingly large number of five items (Questions 1, 3, 5, 6 and 11) proved to be rather ‘easier’ than
expected. Two items (Questions 2 and 21) proved to be more ‘difficult’ than the test specification intended.
